bottlenecks.suggested_experiment: Feature curated film magazine guides on the film hub to provide immediate contextual entry points.
bottlenecks.limitations: Assumes single-title catalog context (The Bat Whispers); multi-film catalog dynamics are out of scope.

bottlenecks.suggested_experiment: Provide instant 1-click sample scene reframe demonstration without requiring navigation.
bottlenecks.limitations: Traffic source intent is assumed rather than tracked through real attribution funnels.

bottlenecks.suggested_experiment: Test progressive disclosure of evidence cards and explicit trust label tooltips to reduce cognitive density.
bottlenecks.limitations: Synthetic reading patience model assumes linear text processing; real viewers may skim or jump to media clips.

bottlenecks.suggested_experiment: Test inline spoil-guard toggles with contextual preview rather than modal interruption.
bottlenecks.limitations: Simulation treats spoiler tolerance as a static trait; real viewers may adjust tolerance per film genre.

bottlenecks.suggested_experiment: Highlight canonical timestamps and scene anchors immediately upon reveal selection.
bottlenecks.limitations: Model cannot observe real visual recognition speed of plot twists.

bottlenecks.suggested_experiment: Offer scaffolded theory templates and pre-populated evidence picker to lower writing activation energy.
bottlenecks.limitations: Assumes deterministic effort thresholds; creative writing motivation varies widely across fan communities.
